source_algorithm: v2 compact SLM2 phase correction with scalar strength regularisation
selection_reason: strongest tested correction in the refined sweep that retained q=20 on every winding contour; larger tested strengths improved intensity correlation but changed the innermost winding

comparison_to_unregularised_v2.reason_rejected: higher intensity closure but failed the q=20 topology check on the innermost tested contour

comparison_to_full_adjoint_phase_only.reason_rejected: worse optical/detector closure and stronger topological distortion than the regularised v2 candidate

interpretation.optical_field: The converged numerical field contains concentric q=20 Bessel/vortex rings.
interpretation.camera_prediction: The explicit 5.5 um BeamGage pixel response suppresses fine radial ring structure and can produce a visibly cross-like sampled appearance.
interpretation.poster_use: May be shown as model-space numerical correction validation. It must not be labelled as a measured post-correction BeamGage result.

hardware_blockers: SLM2-to-axicon/input-plane conjugacy and coordinate transform are not independently bench calibrated
SLM2 parity, rotation, transverse scale and centre are not independently measured
SLM2 1030 nm grey-to-phase LUT / phase stroke is not calibrated
no new post-correction measured q=20 z-stack has yet been acquired for acceptance
